state.output:
kg indexes a repository's symbols and call/inheritance edges into a local
SQLite index. It is consultative only: no hooks, no daemon, no network,
no writes outside .kg/.

Usage: kg [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  build         Index the repository into .kg/index.db (full atomic replacement)
  callers       Who calls this symbol
  callees       What does this symbol call
  context       One-call symbol context: definition + signature, direct callers, and direct callees over resolved edges. Resolved static edges only
  implementers  Who inherits from or implements this symbol (resolved inherits edges)
  imports       What does this file import (outbound resolved imports)
  tests         Which tests reach this symbol or file (static call-edge candidates)
  path          Shortest call path between two symbols via resolved call edges. Resolved static edges only — dynamic dispatch may hide paths. A reverse question is the same query with swapped arguments
  impact        Files that call into <file> (impact direction: callers of the file)
  dead          Dead-code candidates: indexed symbols with zero inbound call edges. Candidates only — dynamic dispatch and entry points are not proven absent
  unresolved    Per-file unresolved-callee counts (where kg could not resolve calls)
  symbols       Symbols of one indexed file, ordered by line
  complexity    Per-symbol complexity ranking (cyclomatic, branches, nesting, effective LOC)
  api           Public/exported symbol inventory for a file or directory
  resolve       Batch-resolve names from stdin (found/ambiguous/missing)
  files         Indexed file inventory with symbol/byte counts
  search        Symbol-level search: bm25-ranked FTS5 over identifier tokens
  clones        Duplicate-block candidates: normalized 5-line-window shingle matches
  stats         Index totals: files, symbols, edges, parse errors, sizes
  hotspots      Pain-ranking of files: cyclomatic + LOC + churn-90d + fix-density

content.text:
kg indexes a repository's symbols and call/inheritance edges into a local
SQLite index. It is consultative only: no hooks, no daemon, no network,
no writes outside .kg/.

Usage: kg [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  build         Index the repository into .kg/index.db (full atomic replacement)
  callers       Who calls this symbol
  callees       What does this symbol call
  context       One-call symbol context: definition + signature, direct callers, and direct callees over resolved edges. Resolved static edges only
  implementers  Who inherits from or implements this symbol (resolved inherits edges)
  imports       What does this file import (outbound resolved imports)
  tests         Which tests reach this symbol or file (static call-edge candidates)
  path          Shortest call path between two symbols via resolved call edges. Resolved static edges only — dynamic dispatch may hide paths. A reverse question is the same query with swapped arguments
  impact        Files that call into <file> (impact direction: callers of the file)
  dead          Dead-code candidates: indexed symbols with zero inbound call edges. Candidates only — dynamic dispatch and entry points are not proven absent
  unresolved    Per-file unresolved-callee counts (where kg could not resolve calls)
  symbols       Symbols of one indexed file, ordered by line
  complexity    Per-symbol complexity ranking (cyclomatic, branches, nesting, effective LOC)
  api           Public/exported symbol inventory for a file or directory
  resolve       Batch-resolve names from stdin (found/ambiguous/missing)
  files         Indexed file inventory with symbol/byte counts
  search        Symbol-level search: bm25-ranked FTS5 over identifier tokens
  clones        Duplicate-block candidates: normalized 5-line-window shingle matches
  stats         Index totals: files, symbols, edges, parse errors, sizes
  hotspots      Pain-ranking of files: cyclomatic + LOC + churn-90d + fix-density
  report        Four-section architecture report (overview, map, hotspots, fan-in)
  doctor        Inspect index health (integrity, versions, staleness, orphans)
  usage         Summarize the usage journal: calls, errors, latency, empty/stale rates. --verify replays sampled payload pointers against current source
  mcp           Run the MCP stdio server (newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0; Amendment 8)
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)
